messages:
Maya: OK — putting a draft out. Q3 OKR is 'Predictable inference at scale'. I want concrete launch gates for routing + tenant isolation that tie back to OKRs. Thoughts?
Priya: +1. We need clear SLOs (p99 latency, error budget), and a separation test for noisy tenants.
Omar: Agree. Operationally this means: affinity routing, fallback chains, and a canary ability to route X% traffic to a new policy.
Sam: Can we define the runbook up front? e.g., detection -> throttle -> evict -> failover. Also what are the alert thresholds?
Jordan: From customers: two asks — per-tenant burst reservations and region residency controls. Top enterprise wants no cross-region routing by default.
Maya: Good callouts. Proposed launch gates (draft): 1) Telemetry: per-tenant latency & cost dashboards, 2) Canary: policy rollout to <1% with automatic rollback, 3) Isolation test: simulated noisy tenant won't degrade others >5% p99, 4) Economics: quantized cost delta <=10% for typical workloads, 5) Compliance: residency flag honored end-to-end.
Omar: For implementation we'll need: policy DSL changes, routing controller support for affinity and fallback, and a deterministic order of policy precedence. I'll sketch an RFC.
Priya: Add a gating matrix row for model-aware routing: prefer quantized or small-ctx variants when cost SLO triggers. Gate = accuracy regression <1% vs baseline on eval prompts.
Sam: Load testing plan: run mixed-tenant synthetic traffic at 2x expected peak for 1h, inject noisy tenant with small hot keys, validate tail latency and queue depths. Also test evictions and recovery.
Jordan: Can we map customer tier to these gates? e.g., self-serve gets soft controls, enterprise gets hard residency + dedicated lanes. Sales needs a checklist to promise in contracts.
Maya: Yes — propose three launch personas: Self-serve (opt-in), Committed (Reserved lanes, SLA), Enterprise (VPC/residency + hard isolation). Each has explicit gates.
Omar: Implementation notes: prefer incremental platform flags, not big-bang. Example config snippet: 
```
routing_policy:
  - match: tenant.tier == "enterprise"
    action: route_to: enterprise-lane
  - fallback: regional-affinity -> global-fallback
```
Priya: Nice. Also include automated regression checks linked to Optimize: before enabling a routing policy, run the prompt set eval to ensure quality preserved.
Sam: Ops checklist items: monitoring (per-tenant p50/p95/p99), billing deltas, quota enforcement, circuit-breakers, automated rollback hook. Who owns each?
Maya: I'll assign owners in the RFC. Immediate asks: Priya draft gating matrix, Omar draft RFC for controller + DSL, Sam draft load test and runbook, Jordan compile top 5 customer residency asks. Can we have drafts by EOD Wednesday?
Omar: I can do the controller sketch by Wed.
Priya: Will start gating matrix. Quick Q: do we treat model variants as separate tenants for isolation math?
Maya: Treat them as first-class decision points in the policy DSL — we need per-variant telemetry.
Jordan: I'll share customer writeups and prioritize the asks.
Sam: Also schedule a dry-run in staging next week for canary rollback.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window available Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please tag your RFC PRs for the release.
Maya: Perfect. Let's sync Friday 9am to review gating matrix & RFC drafts. Thanks all :thumbsup:
